title: Tom Holland and Gordon Ramsay Bond Over A Spicy Fried Chicken Sandwich
description:
Spider-Man and an Ironman walk into one of the tallest kitchens in Europe… but this isn’t a Marvel movie — it’s Scrambled! This week, Hollywood star and BERO co-founder Tom Holland joins Gordon Ramsay to cook up a seriously spicy fried chicken sandwich using a special BERO marinade. As the heat rises in the kitchen, so does the conversation. It’s hot, it’s hilarious, and it’s Tom like you’ve never seen him before.
